summary:
Iter 91 — Frontend-only verification of (A) Public Home trial copy cleanup + CTA routing and (B) internal org header TrialButton + dialog. All acceptance criteria pass end-to-end.

Home (desktop 1920 & mobile 390): GOLD removed from all promo texts (hero badge now '14 giorni di prova gratuita'; home-register-cta-note '14 giorni di prova gratuita. Nessuna carta di credito richiesta.'; PlansSection on / receives the same claim via prop). Only 2 'GOLD' occurrences remain on the page and they are correctly the plan name labels inside PlansSection (not promo copy). No hero-cta-demo element present; no 'Guarda la demo' string in HTML. All CTAs ('landing-try-cta', 'hero-cta-start-free', 'home-register-cta-btn') point to /registrati with label 'Registrati gratis'. No empty gaps on either viewport.

TrialButton (logged in as test_trialbtn@crmeventqa.it):
- Default 14-day state: data-testid=trial-days-button shows '14 giorni rimasti' (desktop label testid trial-days-label) / '14 gg' (mobile), Tiffany bg (bg-[#0ABAB5]) + black text + CalendarClock icon. aria-label present.
- Click opens trial-dialog with title 'La tua prova gratuita è attiva!', body 'Hai ancora 14 giorni di prova gratuita. Durante questo periodo puoi utilizzare tutte le funzionalità di CRMEvent.' + secondary 'Al termine della prova potrai scegliere il piano più adatto alla tua organizzazione.' Three plan tiles present: trial-dialog-plan-bronze (BRONZE €19/mese Gestione essenziale), -silver (SILVER €49/mese Gestione avanzata), -gold (GOLD €79/mese Gestione completa). CTA trial-dialog-plans-cta label 'Scopri i piani' navigates to /profilo?tab=abbonamento (verified). Title/description contain no word 'GOLD' (verified by substring check). Esc closes dialog; keyboard Tab + Enter opens; X top-right closes.
- Simulated states via Mongo organizations.saas.trial_end:
  * 3 days left -> label '3 giorni rimasti' with amber bg (ring-2 ring-amber-500) and AlertTriangle icon.
  * 1 day left -> label '1 giorno rimasto' (singular, grammatically correct) + amber.
  * Past date -> label 'Prova terminata' with red bg; dialog title 'La tua prova gratuita è terminata' and body 'I tuoi dati restano consultabili. Scegli il piano più adatto…'.
  * saas.plan='silver', saas.stripe_status='active' + trial_end past -> trial-days-button hidden (count=0).
- Legacy QA org (qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it): trial-days-button hidden (count=0) — correct.

Mobile 375px header (trial active): all 6 items visible with no overflow — menu (x=8), trial-days-button '14 gg' (x=63 w=74), search icon, Assistenza (icon-only 40x40 at x=189), news, notifications (x=281), profile (x=327 w=40). Max right edge = 367 < 375 viewport, no horizontal scroll. Trial dialog box = 375x484 at y=360 inside 844 viewport; content fits with internal scroll (overflow-y-auto, max-h-[90dvh]).

Residual trial_end state reset back to 14 days after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: TrialButton.jsx:48 'days_left' is read from backend /saas/me response — appears to be a ceiling of (trial_end - now) in days. The label switches cleanly between plural/singular ('N giorni rimasti' vs '1 giorno rimasto'). Looks good.
TrialButton.jsx:50 for ended state, button text is 'Prova terminata' but requirement spec also mentions 'Prova terminata (red)' which matches (bg-red-600). OK.
TrialButton.jsx:62 Dialog uses max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl — on mobile 375 the dialog correctly fits with internal scroll. Good a11y choice.

LandingPage.jsx:375 passes claim='14 giorni di prova gratuita. Nessuna carta di credito richiesta.' into PlansSection, which falls back to the GOLD-mentioning text when no claim is provided. On /prezzi (which does not override claim) the GOLD wording is kept per requirement — verified only indirectly (not retested in this iteration). Low risk.
PlansSection.jsx:92 default fallback still mentions 'Prova GOLD gratis per X giorni' — fine for /prezzi, Home overrides as required.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Home desktop+mobile, QA legacy, trial 14/3/1/expired/purchased, dialog open/close via click+Esc+Enter+X, CTA navigation, mobile 375 header & dialog layout

test_credentials: Used provided creds: test_trialbtn@crmeventqa.it / TestSaas2026! (trial org); qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it / QaEvents2026! (legacy org). No superadmin test required for this scope.
seed_data_creation: No new TEST_ orgs/users/leads created (did not need to register because the agent used provided test_trialbtn@crmeventqa.it and simulated states by patching Mongo). Only mutation performed: toggled organizations.saas.trial_end / plan / stripe_status on the already-existing test_trialbtn trial org — reset back to a 14-day fresh trial at end (trial_end = now+14d, plan=null, stripe_status=null).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything in the review request passes. The test_trialbtn@crmeventqa.it org's saas state was mutated during this run and reset to 14-day fresh trial at the end — if next tester wants a stable pre-condition they should NOT assume welcome_demo is still 'pending' (it was dismissed in a previous iteration). The helper script /tmp/trial_state.py can be reused: `python /tmp/trial_state.py set3|set1|expired|purchased|reset14|status`. Login URL is /login (NOT /accedi — the top-nav 'Accedi' link routes to /login). TrialButton reads days_left from backend via GET /api/saas/me — it reloads on dialog-open, on window focus and every 15 min, so after any Mongo mutation a page reload is enough to see the new state.
